::: {#exm-hidden-layer}

#### The 32 hidden values of one digit

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
hidden = torch.sigmoid(first(x_test[0]))
print(hidden.shape)
print(hidden.detach().numpy().round(2))
```

In @sol-function-between, `torch.sigmoid(first(x))` is a [hidden layer](#def-hidden-layer) of [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width) 32.
For the first test image it holds the 32 numbers printed, each between 0 and 1.
`.detach()` drops the record that [automatic differentiation](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-automatic-differentiation) keeps,
so that NumPy can print the values.

:::
